name: Maintainer Inbox
author: David Boulay
description: Every open issue and pull request on the repositories you own, with a desktop notification for each new one and each reply. Reads GitHub search directly, so watch settings and notifications marked read elsewhere can't hide anything.

barWidget.description: Issues and pull requests on your own repositories that are waiting on you, until you reply or dismiss them.

schema.label: Extra owners
schema.description: Comma-separated users or organizations whose repositories you also maintain. Your own account is always included.

schema.label: Ignore bots
schema.description: Skip items opened by Dependabot, Renovate and other bot accounts.

schema.label: Desktop notifications
schema.description: One per new issue, pull request or reply; a single summary when more than three arrive at once.

schema.label: Warn after failing for (minutes)
schema.description: The widget turns urgent when GitHub could not be checked for this long, so silence never means a failed check.
